snippet.name: backward_difference_derivative
snippet.function:
if (is_first) then is_first = false prevX = time prevY = value end
dx = time - prevX dy = value - prevY prevX = time prevY = value
return dy/dx

snippet.name: central_difference_derivative
snippet.global: firstX = 0 firstY = 0 is_first = true secondX = 0 secondY = 0 is_second = false
snippet.function:
-- Wait for initial values if (is_first) then is_first = false is_second = true firstX = time firstY = value end
if (is_second) then is_second = false secondX = time secondY = value end
-- Central derivative: dy/dx ~= f(x+delta_x)-f(x-delta_x)/(2*delta_x) dx = time - firstX dy = value - firstY -- Increment firstX = secondX firstY = secondY secondX = time secondY = value
return dy/dx

snippet.name: 02_delta_v_from_speed
snippet.global: delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size = 5 delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer = {} delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum = 0 delta_v_from_speed_prev_speed_ma = 0 delta_v_from_speed_prev_time = 0 delta_v_from_speed_prev_delta_v = 0 delta_v_from_speed_min = -5 delta_v_from_speed_max = 3 delta_v_from_speed_initialized = false
snippet.function:
if (delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size < 1) then delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size = 1 end if (delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size > 101) then delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size = 101 end if ((delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size % 2) == 0) then delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size = delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size + 1 end
table.insert(delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer, value) delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum = delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum + value if (#delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer > delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_window_size) then delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum = delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum - delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer[1] table.remove(delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer, 1) end speed_ma = delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_sum / #delta_v_from_speed_v_ma_buffer
if (not delta_v_from_speed_initialized) then delta_v_from_speed_prev_speed_ma = speed_ma delta_v_from_speed_prev_time = time delta_v_from_speed_prev_delta_v = 0 delta_v_from_speed_initialized = true return 0 end
dt = time - delta_v_from_speed_prev_time delta_v = delta_v_from_speed_prev_delta_v
if (dt > 0) then delta_v = (speed_ma - delta_v_from_speed_prev_speed_ma) / dt / 3.6 end if (delta_v < delta_v_from_speed_min) then delta_v = delta_v_from_speed_min end if (delta_v > delta_v_from_speed_max) then delta_v = delta_v_from_speed_max end
delta_v_from_speed_prev_speed_ma = speed_ma delta_v_from_speed_prev_time = time delta_v_from_speed_prev_delta_v = delta_v
return delta_v

snippet.name: 03_dvx_mv_avg
snippet.global: dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size = 5 dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer = {} dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer = {} dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum = 0 dvx_mv_avg_prev_speed_ma = 0 dvx_mv_avg_prev_time = 0 dvx_mv_avg_prev_delta_v = 0 dvx_mv_avg_initialized = false dvx_mv_avg_compensate_time = true dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size = 15 dvx_mv_avg_buffer = {} dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer = {} dvx_mv_avg_sum = 0 dvx_mv_avg_min = -5 dvx_mv_avg_max = 3
snippet.function:
if (dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size < 1) then dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size = 1 end if (dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size > 101) then dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size = 101 end if ((dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size % 2) == 0) then dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size = dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size + 1 end
table.insert(dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer, value) table.insert(dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer, time) dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum = dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum + value if (#dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer > dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_window_size) then dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum = dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum - dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer[1] table.remove(dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer, 1) table.remove(dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer, 1) end speed_ma = dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_sum / #dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_buffer speed_ma_time = time if (#dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer > 1) then speed_ma_time = (dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer[1] + dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer[#dvx_mv_avg_v_ma_time_buffer]) / 2 end
delta_v = dvx_mv_avg_prev_delta_v delta_v_time = speed_ma_time if (not dvx_mv_avg_initialized) then delta_v = 0 dvx_mv_avg_initialized = true else dt = speed_ma_time - dvx_mv_avg_prev_time if (dt > 0) then delta_v = (speed_ma - dvx_mv_avg_prev_speed_ma) / dt / 3.6 end delta_v_time = (speed_ma_time + dvx_mv_avg_prev_time) / 2 end
if (delta_v < dvx_mv_avg_min) then delta_v = dvx_mv_avg_min end if (delta_v > dvx_mv_avg_max) then delta_v = dvx_mv_avg_max end
dvx_mv_avg_prev_speed_ma = speed_ma dvx_mv_avg_prev_time = speed_ma_time dvx_mv_avg_prev_delta_v = delta_v
if (dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size < 1) then dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size = 1 end if (dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size > 101) then dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size = 101 end if ((dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size % 2) == 0) then dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size = dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size + 1 end
table.insert(dvx_mv_avg_buffer, delta_v) table.insert(dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer, delta_v_time) dvx_mv_avg_sum = dvx_mv_avg_sum + delta_v
if (#dvx_mv_avg_buffer > dvx_mv_avg_filter_window_size) then dvx_mv_avg_sum = dvx_mv_avg_sum - dvx_mv_avg_buffer[1] table.remove(dvx_mv_avg_buffer, 1) table.remove(dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer, 1) end
out_time = time if (dvx_mv_avg_compensate_time and #dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer > 1) then out_time = (dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer[1] + dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer[#dvx_mv_avg_time_buffer]) / 2 end
return out_time, dvx_mv_avg_sum / #dvx_mv_avg_buffer

snippet.name: 04_dvx_low_pass
snippet.global: dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size = 5 dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer = {} dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum = 0 dvx_low_pass_prev_speed_ma = 0 dvx_low_pass_prev_time = 0 dvx_low_pass_prev_delta_v = 0 dvx_low_pass_min = -5 dvx_low_pass_max = 3 dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha = 0.91 dvx_low_pass_prev = 0 dvx_low_pass_initialized_acc = false
snippet.function:
if (dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha < 0) then dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha = 0 end if (dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha > 1) then dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha = 1 end
if (dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size < 1) then dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size = 1 end if (dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size > 101) then dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size = 101 end if ((dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size % 2) == 0) then dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size = dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size + 1 end
table.insert(dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer, value) dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum = dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum + value if (#dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer > dvx_low_pass_v_ma_window_size) then dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum = dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum - dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer[1] table.remove(dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer, 1) end speed_ma = dvx_low_pass_v_ma_sum / #dvx_low_pass_v_ma_buffer
delta_v = dvx_low_pass_prev_delta_v if (dvx_low_pass_initialized_acc) then dt = time - dvx_low_pass_prev_time if (dt > 0) then delta_v = (speed_ma - dvx_low_pass_prev_speed_ma) / dt / 3.6 end else delta_v = 0 end if (delta_v < dvx_low_pass_min) then delta_v = dvx_low_pass_min end if (delta_v > dvx_low_pass_max) then delta_v = dvx_low_pass_max end
dvx_low_pass_prev_speed_ma = speed_ma dvx_low_pass_prev_time = time dvx_low_pass_prev_delta_v = delta_v
if (not dvx_low_pass_initialized_acc) then dvx_low_pass_prev = 0 dvx_low_pass_initialized_acc = true return dvx_low_pass_prev end
dvx_low_pass_prev = dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha * dvx_low_pass_prev + (1 - dvx_low_pass_filter_alpha) * delta_v return dvx_low_pass_prev

snippet.name: integral

if (is_first) then is_first = false prevX = time end
dx = time - prevX prevX = time
integral = integral + value*dx

snippet.name: quat_to_roll
snippet.function:
w = value x = v1 y = v2 z = v3
dcm21 = 2 * (w * x + y * z) dcm22 = w*w - x*x - y*y + z*z
roll = math.atan2(dcm21, dcm22)
return roll

snippet.name: quat_to_pitch
snippet.function:
w = value x = v1 y = v2 z = v3
dcm20 = 2 * (x * z - w * y)
pitch = math.asin(-dcm20)
return pitch

snippet.name: quat_to_yaw
snippet.function:
w = value x = v1 y = v2 z = v3
dcm10 = 2 * (x * y + w * z) dcm00 = w*w + x*x - y*y - z*z
yaw = math.atan2(dcm10, dcm00)
return yaw
